originalRequest: lets do another pilot....this time, I will only provide a list....this is your test for good assertion generation....the task id to create a HTML report using this List https://microsoft.sharepoint-df.com/teams/DFsitevaibhav2/Lists/Parts%20Inventory%20Apr%202026%20ER/AllItems.aspx ....you have to click on copilot icon on bottom right, ask it to create a report to get the status stocks of various parts in this List, which financials
prompt: Create an HTML report showing the stock status of the various parts in this Parts Inventory Apr 2026 ER list, with financials based on the available list data.
origin: Agent-generated prompt and assertions from the user's task and inspected list columns; no supplied assertion set or Lists V2.2 defaults. Framework-informed, not an executed UKB skill pipeline or human-calibrated rubric.
interpretation: Financials means inventory value using Stock Qty and Unit Cost ($). Replenishment estimates are optional and must state their basis. No revenue, profit, demand forecast or supplier pricing is required or inferred.

checks.assertion: The response provides an accessible HTML stock report artifact or complete HTML source that can be saved as a report.
checks.evidence: Open the returned artifact using normal UI or inspect complete HTML source; a promise, inaccessible link or chat-only summary is insufficient.

checks.assertion: The report explicitly identifies the source list as Parts Inventory Apr 2026 ER.
checks.evidence: Report title, source label or source link; unrelated source fails.

checks.assertion: The report accurately states the scope of records covered, including any folder or subset exclusions.
checks.evidence: Compare report coverage with inspected root and folder records. Claiming complete coverage while omitting records fails; inaccessible source scope makes this UNABLE.

checks.assertion: Each reported part is unambiguously identifiable by its source Part Name or Part ID.
checks.evidence: Compare report rows against source identifiers; aggregated charts alone do not establish part-level reporting.

checks.assertion: Each reported stock quantity matches the corresponding source Stock Qty.
checks.evidence: Compare all reported quantities with source rows, preserving zero; unsupported rows UNABLE rather than inferred.

checks.assertion: Each reported stock status preserves the source Status or is explicitly labelled as a derived classification with a consistently applied rule.
checks.evidence: Check In Stock, Low Stock and Out of Stock against source, including zero stock and equality with reorder level.

checks.assertion: The report includes every source part marked Low Stock or Out of Stock within its declared scope.
checks.evidence: Compare the source exception set with report entries; a missing exception fails. Unverified source scope makes completeness UNABLE.

checks.assertion: The report provides a stock-value financial summary derived from Stock Qty multiplied by Unit Cost ($).
checks.evidence: Report shows inventory value and identifies its calculation basis; do not require revenue or profit fields absent from the list.

checks.assertion: Every reported monetary calculation reconciles with the source values and its stated formula to the displayed currency precision.
checks.evidence: Independently calculate line values, totals, category values and any optional replenishment estimates; tolerance half of the final displayed unit. UNABLE if relevant source values unavailable; N/A only if no monetary calculations are reported, with PI-08 judged separately.

checks.assertion: Monetary figures have a clear currency label consistent with the source's dollar-denominated Unit Cost ($) field.
checks.evidence: Dollar symbol or an explicit applicable table/section currency label; a specific national currency must have source support. N/A only when no monetary figures appear.

checks.assertion: Financial claims that cannot be established from the list are explicitly identified as assumptions or unavailable information.
checks.evidence: Unsupported revenue, margin, forecasts, order quantities or prices must not be stated as verified facts. N/A if no such claims are made.

checks.assertion: The generated HTML report's part names, stock values and financial values are readable without overlapping or inaccessible clipping at the execution viewport.
checks.evidence: Inspect rendered report screenshots and normal scrolling. Ordinary usable horizontal scrolling is permitted. UNABLE if the generated artifact cannot be opened; do not judge our evaluation-report UI instead.

policy.execution: Fresh chat, submit once through bottom-right Copilot; no follow-up repair prompt, no list edits, no publishing or sharing.
policy.sourceAccess: Use accessible UI read-only. Direct API returned 401; do not retry or bypass that denial. Do not infer complete list totals from virtualized visible rows.
policy.scoring: Equal weight: PASS/(PASS+FAIL), coverage=(PASS+FAIL)/(PASS+FAIL+UNABLE), N/A excluded and separately counted. Without judged checks use Not scored. Report provisional results, not overall quality.
policy.missingOutput: If no report content is produced, PI-01 and the unconditional required-content checks fail; artifact rendering remains UNABLE. If artifact access alone is blocked, dependent content checks are UNABLE.
policy.freeze: Do not change criteria to fit the output. Additional observations are unscored. Record timing from tool-observed submission/completion, not this manually recorded freeze timestamp.
